profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at COUNTRY Financial
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior Software Developer with a demonstrated history of working as a Technical Lead on large-scale application development projects using an agile framework.  Skilled in IT solution design, troubleshooting, database management, and full-stack development.  Strengths include detail-oriented analysis, effective organization, and clear verbal/written communication, among a lifelong desire to learn.

Programming: Java, XML/XSL, JSON, HTML/CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, Node.js, Express, Python (beginner)

OS: Windows, Linux

Database: SQL, DB2, MySQL, MongoDB (noSQL)

Tools/Other: git, SVN, Visio, Heroku, Docker

Personal Interests: rock climbing, reading, logic puzzles

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
As Technical Lead operating under the SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) methodology , I have wide-ranging responsibilities to support and enable the developers and testers on my team, including the following:
◦ Create detailed end-to-end solution designs identifying technical effort needed to efficiently fulfill business expectations, while ensuring adherence enterprise architecture guidelines
◦ Provide high-level analysis and estimates of future enhancements to accurately establish and mature the larger project timeline
◦ Manage strategy and execution of code deployments, while supporting multiple development environments to help reduce instability for ongoing testing effort
◦ Act as first contact to root cause analysis and troubleshooting on post-implementation defects or requests requiring urgent resolutions to the end-user
◦ Interface with enterprise-wide areas to understand and plan for technical impacts or opportunities on the project, such as DevOps, Security, or Data Warehousing

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
◦ Serve as data analysis team lead on a fast-paced, long-term system replacement project which will allow data migration off the mainframe, direct-to-consumer capabilities, and an improved user experience  
◦ Deliver data integration artifacts based on collected requirements, collaborating with business analysts, system architects, and developers to ensure optimal results
◦ Contribute to high-level and detail-level design sessions to determine scope, resource estimates, and development strategy of project items
◦ Manage production support and enhancement of marketing application, regularly providing technical-level solutions and assistance to end-users
◦ Recruit college-level IT interns and coordinate a summer evaluation process to recommend potential new hires

positions.title: ITS Intern
positions.description:
ITS Application Development
◦ Completed a full-time summer internship, primarily in the area of data analysis, and continued part-time throughout final semester of college
◦ Performed database maintenance and analysis of records to ensure data quality and identify possible sources of error; investigated potential data issues through DB2 on a regular basis
◦ Developed a standalone Java program to clean up disabled employee accounts from SAP Business Objects Business Intelligence user database
◦ Generated weekly reports used for management of project resources and allocations in Primavera

positions.title: Technical Stagehand
positions.description:
◦ Responsible for setting up lighting, video, and audio for each event to meet various client needs
◦ Utilized communication skills by serving as the liaison between the organization and clients
◦ Helped to coordinate and carry out event requirements through individual tasks and time management

projects.title: Yes Deer Shop
projects.description: Yes Deer Shop is an exciting small business run by a close friend. In her attempt to transition away from more expensive site templates and to a more flexible platform, I volunteered to partner with her and launch a custom website. I've created YesDeerShop.com using node.js, Express, MongoDB (noSQL), and Bootstrap. At the initial launch in June 2021, the site presents the potential customer user with the product list and relevant shop details. Behind the scenes, the site also presents an "Admin-only" view for logged-in users to manage the content, such as add/edit products or events. I continue to manage the site maintenance and implement enhancements.
